c74object.name: el.sigseq~
c74object.digest: Sample-accurate step sequencer with synchronized ADSR envelope
c74object.description:
el.sigseq~ is a sample-accurate step sequencer with an integrated, synchronized ADSR envelope generator. It steps through a stored sequence of numerical values (such as frequencies or synthesis parameters) and outputs the active value from the first outlet as a sustained audio-rate signal, while simultaneously emitting a matching ADSR envelope from the second outlet. The sequencer can run via an internal tempo and metric subdivision clock, or step in response to external audio-rate clicks (external_clock). A bang can optionally be emitted from the third outlet each time the sequence loops.
Inlets
Inlet 1 [Left Inlet] (signal / messages): External clock trigger input and control message inlet (list, tempo, sigseq, adsrgate, banggate, rand, retro, internal_clock, external_clock, mute). When external_clock is active, non-zero audio samples advance the sequence.
Outlets
Outlet 1 [Left Outlet] (signal): Sequence value output. Emits the current sequence value as a continuous sample-and-hold signal.
Outlet 2 [Middle Outlet] (signal): Synchronized ADSR envelope output (or flat gain when adsrgate is disabled).
Outlet 3 [Right Outlet] (bang): Loop start trigger. Emits a bang on the first step of each sequence repetition when banggate is enabled.

inlet.description: Receives audio-rate click impulses to step the sequence when external clocking is enabled, as well as sequence definitions and configuration commands.

outlet.description: Outputs the active sequence value as a continuous sample-and-hold audio signal.
Outputs the synchronized ADSR envelope curve for each step (or flat gain if adsrgate is off).
Emits a bang on the first step of each sequence cycle when banggate is turned on.

objarg.name: tempo
objarg.description: The tempo in beats per minute for the internal clock (default: 120.0 BPM).

objarg.name: beat-subdivision
objarg.description: The number of sequence steps per beat (default: 2, e.g. 2 = eighth notes, 4 = sixteenth notes).

objarg.name: flat-gain
objarg.description: The constant gain emitted from the envelope outlet when adsrgate is turned off (default: 0.5).

method.name: adsrgate
method.description: When set to 1 (default), synthesizes an ADSR envelope on each step from the middle outlet. When set to 0, emits constant flat gain instead.

method.name: banggate
method.description: When set to 1, emits a bang from the third outlet whenever the sequence restarts at index 0. When set to 0 (default), bang output is suppressed.

method.name: external_clock
method.description: When set to 1, pauses the internal clock and advances the sequence step-by-step only upon receiving non-zero audio clicks in the inlet.

method.name: gozero
method.description: Resets the sequence playhead so that the next step starts at index 0.

method.name: internal_clock
method.description: When set to 1 (default), advances the sequence automatically according to tempo and beat subdivision.

method.name: list
method.description: Enters a new sequence as a list of numbers (up to 1024 values) and resets the playhead to index 0.

method.name: mute
method.description: When set to 1, mutes DSP computation and outputs silence on both signal outlets. When set to 0 (default), normal output resumes.

method.name: rand
method.description: When set to 1, sequence values are chosen at random on each step. When set to 0 (default), values advance in sequential order.

method.name: retro
method.description: When set to 1, plays the sequence in reverse order. When set to 0 (default), plays forward.

method.name: sigseq
method.description: Configures the step envelope using a 4-element list: [attack_ms, decay_ms, release_ms, sustain_gain]. Attack, decay, and release times are specified in milliseconds. The sustain stage automatically fills the remaining duration of the step.

method.name: tempo
method.description: Sets the internal clock tempo in beats per minute. Step and envelope durations scale immediately while maintaining sync.

method.name: signal
method.description: When external_clock is active, each non-zero audio sample advances the sequence by one step.
